entities.summary: Toshihiro Nagoshi  is a Japanese video game producer, director, and designer. He was the chief creative officer for Sega until 2021 when he became creative director. He went on to be the general director of Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio, and later became a member of the board of directors for Atlus. He joined Sega in 1989. After working at Sega for 30 years, Nagoshi left the company and founded Nagoshi Studio in late 2021.
